Use healthy and disease free planting material
Monitoring: Adults and nymphs of the insect occur in large numbers on the under-surfaces of cassava leaves covered with large amounts of white waxy materials
Look for the presence of honey dew on leaves
Look under the leaves for the presence of adults and immature stages
Look for the presence of ants
Presence of whitish powdery substance on the under surface of the leaf
Look for yellow and chlorotic infested leaves
Apply green direct control whenever infestation is observed
Direct Control: Spray infested plant with mineral oil and a mixture of soap and water
Remove infested plants and/or plant parts like leaves to avoid pest build-up
Up root entire plant and destroy after harvest to destroy eggs
Restrictions: Target the adult by occasionally spraying with
Chlorpyrifos at the rate of 70 ml per gallon of water

II (Moderately hazardous); Apply early in the morning or late in the evening; Avoid entry of field for 48 hours after spraying; Restrict the movement of animals into the sprayed site; Pre-harvest interval: two weeks after spraying; Apply a maximum of two times per season
